title: Semi-Slav Defense: the ideas
line: Two pawns hold the center, then Black takes on c4 and strikes back with the king pawn.

steps.text: White starts by pushing the pawn in front of its queen two squares, into the center.
Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares too. It holds the center.

also.g8f6: That is the start of the Indian defenses, also sound. This lesson pushes the pawn.

steps.after: White offers a side pawn to pull your center pawn away. This is the Queen's Gambit.

steps.text: Guard your center pawn with the pawn on c7.

also.e7e6: That is the Queen's Gambit Declined, also sound. This lesson builds the Semi-Slav with the other pawn first.
also.d5c4: That is the Queen's Gambit Accepted, also sound. This lesson keeps the center pawn.

steps.after: This is the Slav Defense so far.

steps.text: Bring the knight out. It guards the center pawn too.

also.e7e6: That reaches the Semi-Slav by another move order, also sound. This lesson brings the knight out first.
also.d5c4: Taking the pawn is sound too. This lesson brings the knight out first.

steps.text: Move the pawn in front of your king one square. Now two pawns guard your center pawn.

also.d5c4: That heads for the Czech Variation of the Slav, also sound. This lesson builds the Semi-Slav.
also.a7a6: That is the Chebanenko Slav, also sound. This lesson builds the Semi-Slav.
also.g7g6: That is the Schlechter Slav, also sound. This lesson builds the Semi-Slav.

steps.after: This is the Semi-Slav. Your bishop on c8 is shut in for now, and you have a plan to free it.

steps.text: Bring the other knight out behind the pawns. It backs up the king pawn for later.
Bring the bishop out. It also watches e5, where your king pawn wants to go.
Castle. Your king is safe before the center opens.
Take the pawn on c4 now that White's bishop has moved. The bishop spends a second move to take back.
Push the king pawn two squares. It strikes at the center. Once the knight on d7 moves, the bishop on c8 can come out.

also.b7b5: That chases the bishop and takes space, the most played move here. This lesson strikes in the center.
also.a7a6: That gets the pawn push ready, also sound. This lesson strikes in the center.

steps.after: Black has its share of the center.

summary: Two pawns hold the center first. Black takes the side pawn when it gains a move, then frees its bishop with a pawn push.
